spec.name: Halloween Carving Pumpkin
spec.description: Plain, uncarved orange pumpkin with a squat stepped silhouette and small green-brown stem. Connected axis-aligned solids on an even-coordinate carving grid; no facial features or decorations.

prompt: A plain uncarved squat orange pumpkin with a small green-brown stem. Connected axis aligned cuboids, no face, rounded stepped silhouette, all elements on even integer coordinates in x,y,z0..16, detailed orange rind and pumpkin flesh. No rotations. Will be subdivided into an interactive carving grid preserving this generated surface artwork. Original Orange SMP Halloween asset. Vanilla Minecraft pixel scale, material-specific irregular detail, developed UV-mapped surfaces and purposeful connected cuboids. No text, no unrelated scene, no stands, no animations, no bones except the required armor rig. Preserve transparent negative space. Model geometry must be axis-aligned, with no rotated elements. Use local vanilla references for glass, pumpkin rind, wood, iron and inventory sprites. Generated artwork will be used directly in a Paper resource pack.
